title: 半長模擬考 B
summary: 正式多益一半的份量：聽力 50 題＋閱讀 50 題，限時 60 分鐘，交卷後看各 Part 成績和預估分數。

questions.prompt: 看照片，聽 4 個句子，選出最符合照片的描述
questions.explanation:
正確答案 (B) A traffic light stands near a building.
逐字稿：(A) A car is being washed.（一輛車正在被清洗）　(B) A traffic light stands near a building.（紅綠燈立在大樓附近）　(C) Some people are riding bicycles.（有些人在騎腳踏車）　(D) The road is covered with leaves.（路上滿是落葉）

questions.prompt: 看照片，聽 4 個句子，選出最符合照片的描述
questions.explanation:
正確答案 (C) Two chairs have been placed at a table.
逐字稿：(A) A waiter is pouring water.（服務生在倒水）　(B) The table is being cleared.（桌子正在被收拾）　(C) Two chairs have been placed at a table.（桌子旁擺了兩張椅子）　(D) Food is being served.（食物正在被端上桌）

questions.prompt: 看照片，聽 4 個句子，選出最符合照片的描述
questions.explanation:
正確答案 (D) A microwave has been placed on a counter.
逐字稿：(A) A cup is being filled with coffee.（杯子正在被倒滿咖啡）　(B) The cabinets are being repaired.（櫥櫃正在被修理）　(C) Someone is opening a drawer.（有人在開抽屜）　(D) A microwave has been placed on a counter.（流理台上放著一台微波爐）

questions.prompt: 看照片，聽 4 個句子，選出最符合照片的描述
questions.explanation:
正確答案 (A) Several suitcases are standing in a row.
逐字稿：(A) Several suitcases are standing in a row.（幾個行李箱排成一排）　(B) Passengers are boarding a plane.（乘客正在登機）　(C) Some bags are being weighed.（有些包包正在被秤重）　(D) A worker is cleaning the window.（一名工人在擦窗戶）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
Where 問地點。(B) sent 和郵局有關但沒回答地點。
逐字稿：Where's the nearest post office?（最近的郵局在哪裡？）　(A) I sent it yesterday.（我昨天寄了）　(B) Two blocks down this street.（沿著這條街走兩個街區）　(C) At nine thirty.（九點半）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
Who 問人，回答「Ramos 小姐」。
逐字稿：Who's in charge of the new project?（誰負責這個新專案？）　(A) Ms. Ramos is.（Ramos 小姐）　(B) It's a big project.（這是個大專案）　(C) Next Monday.（下週一）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
When 問時間。
逐字稿：When will the repairs be finished?（修理什麼時候會完成？）　(A) The repair shop.（修理店）　(B) Yes, they are.（是的，它們是）　(C) By the end of the week.（這週結束前）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
間接回答：不知道原因，去問警衛。
逐字稿：Why is the meeting room locked?（會議室為什麼鎖著？）　(A) It's on the second floor.（在二樓）　(B) I'll ask security.（我去問警衛）　(C) Yes, at three.（是的，三點）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
How 問方式，回答交通工具。(B) 重複 quick，是陷阱。
逐字稿：How did you get here so quickly?（你怎麼這麼快就到了？）　(A) I took the subway.（我搭地鐵）　(B) It's very quick.（它很快）　(C) About ten people.（大約十個人）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
邀請，回答「很樂意」。(B) 重複 join，是陷阱。
逐字稿：Would you like to join us for lunch?（要不要跟我們一起吃午餐？）　(A) I joined last year.（我去年加入的）　(B) The lunch box.（午餐盒）　(C) I'd love to.（我很樂意）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
選擇疑問句，選「現在訂」。
逐字稿：Should we order more paper or wait until next week?（我們要現在多訂一些紙，還是等到下週？）　(A) The paper is white.（紙是白色的）　(B) Let's order it now.（現在就訂吧）　(C) Yes, I waited.（是的，我等了）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
附加問句在確認，回答「見過」並說明在哪。(C) 用 it 指人是錯的。
逐字稿：You've met our new director, haven't you?（你見過我們的新主管了，對吧？）　(A) Yes, at last week's meeting.（見過，在上週的會議）　(B) The director's office.（主管的辦公室）　(C) No, I didn't meet it.（不，我沒見過它）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
Why don't we 是提議，(B) Because 是陷阱。
逐字稿：Why don't we reserve a table for Friday?（我們何不訂星期五的位子？）　(A) Because it's full.（因為客滿了）　(B) The table is wooden.（桌子是木頭的）　(C) Good idea. I'll call now.（好主意，我現在就打）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
直述句：說影印機壞了，回答「找技術人員」。
逐字稿：The copier on the third floor isn't working.（三樓的影印機壞了。）　(A) Three copies, please.（請印三份）　(B) I'll call the technician.（我來打給技術人員）　(C) It works for a bank.（它為一家銀行工作）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
How often 問頻率，回答「一個月兩次」。How long 才是問多久。
逐字稿：How often do you visit the Tokyo office?（你多久去一次東京辦公室？）　(A) About twice a month.（大約一個月兩次）　(B) It's a big office.（那是個大辦公室）　(C) For two hours.（兩個小時）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
否定疑問句：沒到就說 No，再說原因。
逐字稿：Didn't the shipment arrive this morning?（貨不是今天早上到嗎？）　(A) I'll ship it.（我會寄出）　(B) In the morning paper.（在晨報上）　(C) No, it's been delayed.（沒有，延誤了）

questions.prompt: 聽問題和 3 個回答，選出最適合的回答
questions.explanation:
答應請求。(B) soft 和 software 很像，是陷阱。
逐字稿：Can you show me how to use this software?（你可以教我怎麼用這個軟體嗎？）　(A) It's a soft chair.（那是張軟椅子）　(B) Sure, have a seat.（當然，請坐）　(C) I used it yesterday.（我昨天用過）

questions.prompt: 說話者最可能在哪裡？
questions.explanation:
reservation、key、room 都表示在飯店櫃台。
逐字稿：M: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Carter.　W: Welcome, Mr. Carter. You're staying for two nights, right?　M: That's right. Is breakfast included?　W: Yes, it's served from 6:30 to 10 in the restaurant on the first floor. Here's your key. Your room is on the eighth floor.
questions.sentence: Where most likely are the speakers?

questions.prompt: 男子會住多久？
questions.explanation:
You're staying for two nights. eighth 是樓層。
逐字稿：M: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Carter.　W: Welcome, Mr. Carter. You're staying for two nights, right?　M: That's right. Is breakfast included?　W: Yes, it's served from 6:30 to 10 in the restaurant on the first floor. Here's your key. Your room is on the eighth floor.
questions.sentence: How long will the man stay?

questions.prompt: 早餐在哪裡供應？
options: In a restaurant on the first floor
questions.answer: In a restaurant on the first floor
questions.explanation:
served in the restaurant on the first floor。
逐字稿：M: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Carter.　W: Welcome, Mr. Carter. You're staying for two nights, right?　M: That's right. Is breakfast included?　W: Yes, it's served from 6:30 to 10 in the restaurant on the first floor. Here's your key. Your room is on the eighth floor.
questions.sentence: Where is breakfast served?

questions.prompt: 男子提到什麼問題？
questions.explanation:
the delivery will be late：送貨會晚到。
逐字稿：W: Hi, James. The printer is almost out of ink. Did you order more?　M: I did, but the supplier said the delivery will be late. It won't arrive until Thursday.　W: Thursday? I need to print the training handouts tomorrow.　M: You could use the printer on the fifth floor. I'll let them know you're coming.
questions.sentence: What problem does the man mention?

questions.prompt: 女子明天需要做什麼？
questions.explanation:
I need to print the training handouts tomorrow.
逐字稿：W: Hi, James. The printer is almost out of ink. Did you order more?　M: I did, but the supplier said the delivery will be late. It won't arrive until Thursday.　W: Thursday? I need to print the training handouts tomorrow.　M: You could use the printer on the fifth floor. I'll let them know you're coming.
questions.sentence: What does the woman need to do tomorrow?

questions.prompt: 男子建議什麼？
questions.explanation:
You could use the printer on the fifth floor. 用別台印表機。
逐字稿：W: Hi, James. The printer is almost out of ink. Did you order more?　M: I did, but the supplier said the delivery will be late. It won't arrive until Thursday.　W: Thursday? I need to print the training handouts tomorrow.　M: You could use the printer on the fifth floor. I'll let them know you're coming.
questions.sentence: What does the man suggest?

questions.prompt: 說話者在計畫什麼？
questions.explanation:
I'd like to talk about the company picnic.
逐字稿：W: Thanks for meeting with me. I'd like to talk about the company picnic.　M1: Sure. Last year it was at Lakeside Park, and everyone enjoyed it.　M2: But it rained in the afternoon, remember? This year, maybe we should rent a place with a roof.　W: Good point. Mark, could you look for places and send me a list by Friday?　M2: No problem.
questions.sentence: What are the speakers planning?

questions.prompt: 去年發生了什麼事？
questions.explanation:
it rained in the afternoon：下午下雨了。
逐字稿：W: Thanks for meeting with me. I'd like to talk about the company picnic.　M1: Sure. Last year it was at Lakeside Park, and everyone enjoyed it.　M2: But it rained in the afternoon, remember? This year, maybe we should rent a place with a roof.　W: Good point. Mark, could you look for places and send me a list by Friday?　M2: No problem.
questions.sentence: What happened last year?

questions.prompt: 其中一名男子被要求做什麼？
questions.explanation:
could you look for places and send me a list by Friday?
逐字稿：W: Thanks for meeting with me. I'd like to talk about the company picnic.　M1: Sure. Last year it was at Lakeside Park, and everyone enjoyed it.　M2: But it rained in the afternoon, remember? This year, maybe we should rent a place with a roof.　W: Good point. Mark, could you look for places and send me a list by Friday?　M2: No problem.
questions.sentence: What is one of the men asked to do?

questions.prompt: 女子為什麼想換貨？
options: She does not like the color.
questions.explanation:
it's too small：太小了。
逐字稿：W: Excuse me. I bought this shirt here yesterday, but it's too small. Can I exchange it?　M: Of course. Do you have the receipt?　W: Yes, here. Do you have it in a large?　M: Let me check. Hmm, we don't have large in blue, but we have it in gray.　W: Gray is fine.
questions.sentence: Why does the woman want an exchange?

questions.prompt: 男子要求看什麼？
questions.explanation:
Do you have the receipt?
逐字稿：W: Excuse me. I bought this shirt here yesterday, but it's too small. Can I exchange it?　M: Of course. Do you have the receipt?　W: Yes, here. Do you have it in a large?　M: Let me check. Hmm, we don't have large in blue, but we have it in gray.　W: Gray is fine.
questions.sentence: What does the man ask for?

questions.prompt: 女子最後可能拿到什麼顏色？
questions.explanation:
藍色沒有 large，她說 Gray is fine。
逐字稿：W: Excuse me. I bought this shirt here yesterday, but it's too small. Can I exchange it?　M: Of course. Do you have the receipt?　W: Yes, here. Do you have it in a large?　M: Let me check. Hmm, we don't have large in blue, but we have it in gray.　W: Gray is fine.
questions.sentence: What color will the woman probably get?

questions.prompt: 女子為什麼打電話？
questions.explanation:
invite you to a second interview：安排第二次面試。
逐字稿：W: Hello, this is Rachel from Hartley Bank. We'd like to invite you to a second interview.　M: That's great! When would it be?　W: Would Wednesday at two work for you?　M: I'm afraid I have a class then. Is Thursday possible?　W: Yes, Thursday at two is fine. You'll meet our branch manager.
questions.sentence: Why is the woman calling?

questions.prompt: 男子說「恐怕我那時有課」是什麼意思？
options: He is worried about a test.
He wants to teach a class.
questions.explanation:
星期三兩點他有課，所以不能來，接著問星期四可不可以。
逐字稿：W: Hello, this is Rachel from Hartley Bank. We'd like to invite you to a second interview.　M: That's great! When would it be?　W: Would Wednesday at two work for you?　M: I'm afraid I have a class then. Is Thursday possible?　W: Yes, Thursday at two is fine. You'll meet our branch manager.
questions.sentence: What does the man mean when he says, "I'm afraid I have a class then"?

questions.prompt: 男子會見到誰？
questions.explanation:
You'll meet our branch manager.
逐字稿：W: Hello, this is Rachel from Hartley Bank. We'd like to invite you to a second interview.　M: That's great! When would it be?　W: Would Wednesday at two work for you?　M: I'm afraid I have a class then. Is Thursday possible?　W: Yes, Thursday at two is fine. You'll meet our branch manager.
questions.sentence: Who will the man meet?

questions.prompt: 說話者最可能在哪裡？
questions.explanation:
platform、train 表示在火車站。
逐字稿：M: Excuse me, is this the platform for the train to Boston?　W: It was, but the train has been moved to platform six because of track repairs.　M: Oh, thanks. Is it still leaving at 10:15?　W: It'll be about twenty minutes late. You can get a coffee at the café upstairs while you wait.
questions.sentence: Where most likely are the speakers?

questions.prompt: 火車為什麼換月台？
questions.explanation:
because of track repairs：因為軌道維修。
逐字稿：M: Excuse me, is this the platform for the train to Boston?　W: It was, but the train has been moved to platform six because of track repairs.　M: Oh, thanks. Is it still leaving at 10:15?　W: It'll be about twenty minutes late. You can get a coffee at the café upstairs while you wait.
questions.sentence: Why has the train been moved?

questions.prompt: 女子建議什麼？
questions.explanation:
You can get a coffee at the café upstairs.
逐字稿：M: Excuse me, is this the platform for the train to Boston?　W: It was, but the train has been moved to platform six because of track repairs.　M: Oh, thanks. Is it still leaving at 10:15?　W: It'll be about twenty minutes late. You can get a coffee at the café upstairs while you wait.
questions.sentence: What does the woman suggest?

questions.prompt: 什麼改變了？
questions.explanation:
The departure gate has changed：登機門改了。
逐字稿：Attention, passengers on Sky Air flight 720 to London. The departure gate has changed from Gate 14 to Gate 32. Boarding will begin at 4:45. Passengers traveling with small children may board first. Thank you.
questions.sentence: What has changed?

questions.prompt: 幾點開始登機？
questions.explanation:
Boarding will begin at 4:45. 720 是班機號碼。
逐字稿：Attention, passengers on Sky Air flight 720 to London. The departure gate has changed from Gate 14 to Gate 32. Boarding will begin at 4:45. Passengers traveling with small children may board first. Thank you.
questions.sentence: When will boarding begin?

questions.prompt: 誰可以先登機？
questions.explanation:
Passengers traveling with small children may board first.
逐字稿：Attention, passengers on Sky Air flight 720 to London. The departure gate has changed from Gate 14 to Gate 32. Boarding will begin at 4:45. Passengers traveling with small children may board first. Thank you.
questions.sentence: Who may board first?

questions.prompt: 這段廣播在哪裡播放？
questions.explanation:
shoppers、Fresh Market、fruit and vegetables：超市。
逐字稿：Good afternoon, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Fresh Market. Today only, all fruit and vegetables are buy one, get one free. Also, our bakery has just taken fresh bread out of the oven. Please note that the store will close early today, at 6 p.m., for a staff meeting.
questions.sentence: Where is the announcement being made?

questions.prompt: 今天什麼在特價？
questions.explanation:
all fruit and vegetables are buy one, get one free：買一送一。
逐字稿：Good afternoon, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Fresh Market. Today only, all fruit and vegetables are buy one, get one free. Also, our bakery has just taken fresh bread out of the oven. Please note that the store will close early today, at 6 p.m., for a staff meeting.
questions.sentence: What is on special today?

questions.prompt: 店為什麼提早關門？
questions.explanation:
close early today… for a staff meeting.
逐字稿：Good afternoon, shoppers. Thank you for shopping at Fresh Market. Today only, all fruit and vegetables are buy one, get one free. Also, our bakery has just taken fresh bread out of the oven. Please note that the store will close early today, at 6 p.m., for a staff meeting.
questions.sentence: Why will the store close early?

questions.prompt: 這通電話的目的是什麼？
options: To give a reminder about an appointment
questions.answer: To give a reminder about an appointment
questions.explanation:
I'm calling to remind you about your appointment：提醒預約。
逐字稿：Hi, Mr. Patel. This is Sophie from Lane Dental Office. I'm calling to remind you about your appointment with Dr. Hughes tomorrow at 9 a.m. Please arrive ten minutes early to fill out a form. If you need to change the time, call us at 555-3190. See you tomorrow.
questions.sentence: What is the purpose of the call?

questions.prompt: 聽者被要求做什麼？
questions.explanation:
Please arrive ten minutes early to fill out a form.
逐字稿：Hi, Mr. Patel. This is Sophie from Lane Dental Office. I'm calling to remind you about your appointment with Dr. Hughes tomorrow at 9 a.m. Please arrive ten minutes early to fill out a form. If you need to change the time, call us at 555-3190. See you tomorrow.
questions.sentence: What is the listener asked to do?

questions.prompt: Hughes 醫師最可能是誰？
questions.explanation:
Lane Dental Office 是牙醫診所，Dr. Hughes 是牙醫。
逐字稿：Hi, Mr. Patel. This is Sophie from Lane Dental Office. I'm calling to remind you about your appointment with Dr. Hughes tomorrow at 9 a.m. Please arrive ten minutes early to fill out a form. If you need to change the time, call us at 555-3190. See you tomorrow.
questions.sentence: Who most likely is Dr. Hughes?

questions.prompt: 這段話主要在說什麼？
questions.explanation:
remind everyone about our new travel policy：新的出差規定。
逐字稿：Before we finish, I want to remind everyone about our new travel policy. Starting next month, all business trips must be approved by your manager at least two weeks in advance. Also, please keep all your receipts. You will need them to get your money back. I'll send the full policy by email this afternoon.
questions.sentence: What is the talk mainly about?

questions.prompt: 員工出差前兩週必須做什麼？
questions.explanation:
must be approved by your manager at least two weeks in advance。
逐字稿：Before we finish, I want to remind everyone about our new travel policy. Starting next month, all business trips must be approved by your manager at least two weeks in advance. Also, please keep all your receipts. You will need them to get your money back. I'll send the full policy by email this afternoon.
questions.sentence: What must employees do two weeks before a trip?

questions.prompt: 說話者今天下午會做什麼？
questions.explanation:
I'll send the full policy by email this afternoon.
逐字稿：Before we finish, I want to remind everyone about our new travel policy. Starting next month, all business trips must be approved by your manager at least two weeks in advance. Also, please keep all your receipts. You will need them to get your money back. I'll send the full policy by email this afternoon.
questions.sentence: What will the speaker do this afternoon?

questions.prompt: 下週一會開始什麼？
questions.explanation:
the city's first electric bus service will start next Monday.
逐字稿：In local news, the city's first electric bus service will start next Monday. The new buses will run between the central station and the airport every 15 minutes. A one-way ticket costs $3. City officials hope the service will reduce traffic and air pollution downtown.
questions.sentence: What will start next Monday?

questions.prompt: 公車多久一班？
questions.explanation:
every fifteen minutes。注意 fifteen 和 fifty。
逐字稿：In local news, the city's first electric bus service will start next Monday. The new buses will run between the central station and the airport every 15 minutes. A one-way ticket costs $3. City officials hope the service will reduce traffic and air pollution downtown.
questions.sentence: How often will the buses run?

questions.prompt: 市府官員希望什麼？
options: More people will visit the airport.
questions.explanation:
reduce traffic：減少車流。decrease 是 reduce 的換句話說。
逐字稿：In local news, the city's first electric bus service will start next Monday. The new buses will run between the central station and the airport every 15 minutes. A one-way ticket costs $3. City officials hope the service will reduce traffic and air pollution downtown.
questions.sentence: What do city officials hope?

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: Please 後面接動詞原形 review。
questions.sentence: Please ___ the attached file before the meeting.
questions.zh: 請在開會前看過附件檔案。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: easy to ＋ 動詞原形：很容易做某事。
questions.sentence: The new software is very easy ___ use.

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: be responsible for：負責…。is 後面放形容詞 responsible。
questions.sentence: Mr. Okafor is ___ for the company's marketing.
questions.zh: 奧卡佛先生負責公司的行銷。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 increased，用副詞 steadily。
questions.sentence: Our sales have increased ___ since we opened the new store.
questions.zh: 開新店以來，我們的業績穩定成長。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: 星期幾用 on。
questions.sentence: The package will be delivered ___ Friday.

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: 空格後面是動詞原形 attend，前面要放助動詞 must。
questions.sentence: All employees ___ attend the safety training next week.
questions.zh: 所有員工下週都必須參加安全訓練。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
questions.explanation: for ＋ 一段時間（ten years）。since 後面要接時間點。
questions.sentence: Ms. Grant has worked here ___ ten years.
questions.zh: 葛蘭特小姐在這裡工作十年了。

questions.prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案
